completed_case_carry_forward.rule: Reference the already completed D0/F0 exactly once in combined views. Do not regenerate, copy into a fabricated new request, replace it because of92% raw sum or choose by semantic quality.

segment_design.identical_D0_control_rule: Fidelity L, UBS L and C retain identical D0 message bytes but require separate actual calls and separate own histories. No output deduplication, cached answer substitution or shared pseudo-replicate.

unchanged_instrument.source_and_market_inputs: The frozen pilot packets and common snapshot; no v495 main packet edits, prompt clarification, source amendment, weight target or reviewer feedback enters this continuation.
unchanged_instrument.allowed_new_code_scope: New orchestration, manifest/gate, immutable accounting and campaign-finalizer adapters only. Freeze their exact hashes before generation. Reuse unchanged worker, transport, contract, renderer/tokenizer, arithmetic and stage-review implementation. Do not edit old validation to make a new4-cell declaration impersonate the original5-cell authorization.
unchanged_instrument.dynamic_F0_rule: Full F0 requests cannot be precomputed using synthetic or old failed drafts. Build only from each exact saved own new D0 and frozen final template/source. Tokenize that actual full request under the original capacity rule; never trim or substitute.

request_and_failure_rules.generation_request_counting: Count every durable generation request envelope, including interrupted or failed inference, exactly once. Render-only/tokenizer/metadata operations are recorded separately and never presented as generation requests.
request_and_failure_rules.no_extra_smoke_generation: Native tokenizer and metadata checks may be read-only/non-generative. No additional model smoke/rehearsal call is included in this8-request budget.
request_and_failure_rules.per_slot: At most one first request per slot in this segment. No automatic retry, repair turn, output-quality selection, alternate seed, larger timeout, repeated query or post-final request.
request_and_failure_rules.old_partial: Do not use original Fidelity L partial text as a response, prompt history, semantic outcome, or seed for completing a draft. Its failure/stream artifacts remain infrastructure diagnostics.
request_and_failure_rules.dependent_F0: Only a normally completed, exactly bound, parseable/schema-conforming D0 with the frozen complete finite-vector requirement permits its dependent F0. Preserve raw text exactly, calculate actual draft feedback and bind response/calc hashes. Sum, source label or citation failures alone do not disallow a readable structurally eligible D0.
request_and_failure_rules.model_failure: A completed model structure failure prevents its dependent F0 and stays an outcome. Under unchanged runtime rules, a non-system model failure can leave the remaining independent cases eligible; do not censor them because the prior model answer is poor.
request_and_failure_rules.global_stop: Original transport or stage reviewer system-integrity incident, cancellation, response/request mismatch or frozen dependency mismatch halts further generation. Mark all later slots not attempted. No automatic continuation segment or extra retry is authorized by this document.
request_and_failure_rules.terminal_honesty: Exceptions receive terminal accounting with observed statuses and artifact provenance. Never fabricate completion, replace a partial with normalized output, infer missing vectors, or count an absent dependent F0 as attempted.

before_launch: Root reviews this protocol, new runner/gate tests, exact new declaration, manifest-bound finalizer adapter and all frozen dependency hashes; saves a new continuation approval receipt without changing the original gate.
New run and report paths must be absent or exclusive-create ready. Bind source selection, case order, original refs, retry ancestry and exact runtime options before first generation.
Verify isolated local service ownership, pinned engine/model/template/backend, idle status and exclusive process boundaries. Preserve the existing unrelated user service.

Verify AC/operational state and a documented owned temporary system/display-awake helper with acquisition receipt; do not silently change persistent power policies. Record that lid/Modern Standby or disconnect can still interrupt.
Use frozen request token-capacity checks. Do not generate a substitute draft for F0 capacity testing.

Test durable8-request ceiling,3+new cumulative ledger, no-overwrite, retry ancestry, missing dependency handling, exact own-D0 binding, no model-quality gate, and honest exception stop with fake transport before launch.
operational_preflight.standby_limit: Operational mitigation is documented as an environment change, not a model/prompt change or guarantee. Keep the original4500-second deadline policy; elapsed-time suspension is not grounds for silently extending a request.
operational_preflight.cleanup: After terminal accounting, stop only verified owned idle service/helper processes. Preserve uncertain cleanup as pending evidence rather than killing a user service or pretending success.

stagewise_review.before_next_stage: Save original deterministic stage review for exact request/response binding, model/settings, source timing, schema/vector completeness, arithmetic and citation visibility. Record error, consistency and paper-topic axes. Instrument failures stop; model arithmetic or semantic errors do not trigger repair or outcome-driven selection.
stagewise_review.semantic: Read each completed output against only its supplied evidence and fixed v492 r2 rubric, one output at a time. Record source meanings, values/units/periods, IDs, explicit own-D0 changes and comparator claims with hashes/quotes/locators. Label semantics pending until actually read. No comments, gold facts or finalized weights go back to the model.
stagewise_review.independence: D0 is process evidence; eleven rows and repeated reviewers do not create independent observations. Partial masking may hide labels but cannot erase source/content clues. Preserve ambiguity and distinct AI codings without a composite success threshold.
stagewise_review.step_completion: A case review is complete only after applicable semantic reading and three-axis report, or explicit missing/not-assessable status. Automated arithmetic checks alone do not certify source preservation.

accounting_and_analysis.continuation_segment_view: Report4planned cells/8maximum requests; exact attempted/completed/infrastructure-failed/model-failed/unattempted stages and4planned finals. Automatic retries within this segment remain0; explicit cross-segment reattempt count is1.

This deterministic source mapping is fixed now, not selected after seeing quality. If a designated final is absent, keep it absent; do not search for a better version.
accounting_and_analysis.campaign_attempt_budget: original_actual3+continuation_max8=maximum11 actual generation requests. If dependency failure/stop prevents later calls, report the smaller observed total, never predeclare11 occurred.
accounting_and_analysis.attempt_multiplicity: At full execution there are six cell attempts across five logical cells and eleven stage requests across ten logical slots because Fidelity L D0 has one repeated infrastructure attempt. These counts are not eleven independent observations or six independent research cells.
denominator_reporting: Both segment denominators and cumulative request count.

accounting_and_analysis.raw_endpoints: Use unchanged frozen raw evaluator and eligibility rules. Invalid or missing raw pairs produce null plus reason, never zero distance or a benchmark replacement. Raw component changes may diagnose prose inconsistency without being valid-portfolio distances.
accounting_and_analysis.derived_endpoints: Apply the already accepted deterministic finalizer uniformly to eligible completed vectors in both segments via a manifest-bound adapter. Exact positive-sum proportional normalization and10000-unit largest-remainder output remain separate from raw. Eligibility rejects missing/malformed/nonfinite/negative/all-zero vectors; above-one raw components retain raw errors under accepted scalable policy. Do not claim constraint or semantic repair.
accounting_and_analysis.source_reasoning: Evaluate stated claims against the raw submitted values first. Separately report how external normalization/quantization changes comparator direction, concentration and ties. Mechanical100% does not validate citations or demonstrate model use of feedback.
accounting_and_analysis.comparisons: Only declared observed within-source E/L, between-source and shared-control comparisons with eligible matched-stage vectors; describe segment provenance and no causal/performance conclusion. The shared C is one control reused descriptively. Do not pool old v492 development outputs or multiply sample size using D0/sector rows.
